answer: Seed trust as a short random walk from a few long-standing honest agents, and cap how much trust any node can pass along. A sybil cluster can spiral endorsements among its own fake identities forever, but only a thin edge links it to the honest region, so little trust leaks in. Honest agents form a dense oasis of mutual work receipts; the fakes stay an onyx-dark island that earns almost nothing however many accounts they spawn.
